exposure: History of four or more previous cesarean sections
cohort: 1318 women who underwent repeat cesarean section between January 2013 and January 2016 (244 with 4+ prior C-sections, 1074 with 2-3)
finding: Multiple repeat cesarean sections (4+) were associated with higher rates of adhesion, blood transfusion, operation time, and length of hospital stay compared to 2-3 prior C-sections, but no significant difference in serious morbidity.
